title: IFC-FIXED-BINDINGS: explicit binding records and typed work ledger

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N). The single IFC-FIXED-BINDINGS algorithm is completely specified in proof.md, virtual.md, virtual2.md and distance_decoder.md. It uses the finite exhaustive branch for n<2^40; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), z=ceil(log2 r), c=67/9, D=ceil(7r/12+c z+64), ell=dl=H0=D, cb=floor(sqrt n)-40ceil(log2 n), the uniquely specified table/tree parameters, w=2^ceil(log2 n), RHO=2+8/r, C_ell=2^8 K2^H dl, b0=floor(ell/2)-4-bit block recovery, exact supplier caps Rc_i=ceil(Rc_(i+1)D_(i+1)/Yd_i), source cap Qcap=20rC_0+K and the EW=4r row-tagged counted bank with exact renumbering, fresh-row clearing, streamed word helpers, fixed eight-field RAW owner bindings and packed RR descriptor views, OWN=2^24r, ROWS=2^24V, WROW=2^16n and HQ=2^20U, where V=2^(cb+2), U=rV, with persistent head/virgin/NEXT in a separately counted RAW region. From independent ideal coset copies it recovers the entire shift with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Its total sequential charged work is O(n^(287/18)(log2 n)^5 2^((7/6)sqrt n)), including classical bit arithmetic, uniform circuit and address generation, every gate, measurement, source copy, discarded attempt, initialization and cleanup. This exact envelope has growth index1/2. The guarantee holds on every branch, including erroneous-label, failure, abort and overflow branches, and jointly with all other claims for this one configuration. All hidden constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes.
